title: Nice visuals!
body: I love the way you can see your monthly and yearly performance!
author: RyanHardwood

title: As simple as it should be
body: The app does exactly what you expect it to do. You can track your habits in the most simple way. Keep it up!
author: EleniMantz

title: Simple and on point
body: I want two things from a habit tracker: track habits, see progress over time. It does both of these brilliantly. It has some other bells and whistles too, like ready made posts for bragging about on social media. And these work well too but I want it for its core functionality and it's perfect.
author: dimitris42
